'''Pumpkin Pie''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]].

Pumpkin Pie can be received as a gift at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]].

==Tailoring==
Pumpkin Pie is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Holiday Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt186.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Pumpkin Pie is not used in any [[quests]].

==History==
{{History|1.3.27|The Pumpkin Pie recipe accepts [[Large Milk]] in addition to [[Milk|regular milk]].}}
